verified_facts: title plan is one of three elements of a registered title
title plan must be viewed with the register
title plans are based on Ordnance Survey mapping
adjoining title plans may use different OS-map editions
title plan identifies the general extent of registered land
all title plans show general boundaries unless a line is determined
title-plan scale or red edging must not be treated as an exact legal-boundary coordinate
quality_effect: Requires register/title-plan context and OS-map epoch before using title geometry.
